transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi. Nice to meet you too. Um, I decided to come in because... well, lately, especially after some really long days out on the site, or if I've had a late neighborhood meeting, I’ll come home and just eat way more than I meant to. 

I'll just kind of go through whatever's there—leftover takeout, cereal, chips, just whatever is around—and I don't really stop until I’m just uncomfortably full. It's been bothering me enough that I figured I should probably talk to someone about it.
When these eating episodes happen, do you feel like you can’t stop or control how much you’re eating?

Yeah, that's exactly what it feels like. Once I start on those evenings, it's like I'm just on autopilot. I'll be standing there, telling myself I need to stop because I have an early start with the crew the next morning, but... I just keep going back to the kitchen for more anyway. I know I shouldn't, but I just can't seem to make myself stop once I get going.
After these eating episodes, do you ever make yourself vomit to try to undo the eating?

Yeah, um... I do sometimes. Not every time, but maybe a few times a month after those bad nights, I'll go into the bathroom and make myself throw up. I just... I start to panic, honestly. I get really worked up about undoing all the effort I’ve put into staying in shape and looking put-together, especially since I need to maintain a certain presence on the job site. So, yeah, I do make myself sick to try and fix it.
About how often do you make yourself vomit after these eating episodes?

Well, looking back over the last few months... I guess the whole pattern of overeating and then making myself sick averages out to about once a week. It varies, though. Like, some weeks it might happen twice, and then other weeks it won't happen at all. But yeah, if I really average it out, it's probably about weekly.
How much does your body weight or shape affect how you feel about yourself?

It affects me a lot, honestly. Since I started wearing more fitted work clothes and being the one up front running the site meetings... I don't know, I just catch myself judging my whole day based on how I look. Like, if my pants feel even a little tight, or if I think people can see my stomach, it just ruins my mood. It's pretty much always on my mind.

latest_inference.note: Binge eating with loss of control, self-induced vomiting about weekly, and undue influence of body shape/weight on self-evaluation support bulimia nervosa; this rules out binge-eating disorder and unspecified eating disorder.
